llm.guidance: Install only if you want durable local agent memory. Do not store passwords, API keys, tokens, private personal data, confidential business details, or secret locations in this memory store. Review context returned by get_context() before sending it to a model, and treat exported or imported memory JSON as sensitive and untrusted until reviewed.
